Hi Sophia —

Great to lock this in for the week of 7/28. Before we book the courier I'd like to confirm a few logistics to make sure the demo crates and swag clear your receiving and customs without delay: 

- Shipping destination (full street + receiving instructions + dock hours)
- Onsite POC (name + direct mobile) and preferred delivery time window (AM or PM)
- Any building-specific carrier instructions (dock #, loading bay, paperwork at reception)
- Customs / purchase order info we should include on the commercial invoice
- AV / power notes for the demo (1x 120V 20A outlet near conference table; HDMI adapter available?)
- Do you want us to include return labels inside the crate or have us email pre-paid return labels?

We'll send a single pallet (2 crates) with: demo server, 2 laptops, 4 demo kits, printed customer-facing one-pagers and 200 pieces of branded swag. Estimated box dims: 48x40x36 (lbs: 110).

Attaching a packing manifest and tentative label templates for your review. If all good we'll schedule a pickup from our SF fulfillment partner on Tue 7/28 for arrival Wed 7/29.

Thanks —

Priya Natarajan

Thanks Sophia — good details. Two quick asks from logistics: 

1) Oliver/Procurement: can you share the PO number and whether Evergreen requires consignee tax ID or any specific line-item descriptions on the invoice? We typically put: Redwood Inference — Demo Equipment (non-retail) — 2 crates — serials included.

2) Priya / Dev: we'll confirm crate weights and convert to carrier master labels. Dev — can you prep pre-paid return labels and include physical printed copies inside the crate AND email PDFs to procurement?

I've attached updated label templates (carrier and internal) and our suggested commercial invoice language. Priya — if procurement needs a separate customs invoice (healthcare institution) flag that and we'll adapt.

Next steps: once PO is received we'll book QuickShip Logistics for pickup 7/28 (SF) with delivery 7/29 (Seattle AM) and share tracking in this thread.

Ben Carter
